title: Holy cow, Unreal Engine 6 just got officially announced with Rocket League!
author: Ok_Command_3730

replies.author: Ok_Command_3730
replies.body: Right?! I wonder if they are jumping straight from 5.8 to 6, or if we'll see a 5.9 first. This is absolutely crazy!

comments.author: Xijamk
comments.body: I hope the version jump is due to a change that makes it more compatible with MCP servers, or even better, an MCP server created by Unreal Engine itself.

replies.author: Ok_Command_3730
replies.body: That would be huge! Actually, I think 5.8 already includes some experimental MCP support, so hopefully UE6 will take it to the next level and make it completely native and stable

comments.author: PhoenixxBR
comments.body: até hoje ainda não saiu algum jogo decentemente bom em Unreal 5, jogos sempre bugados e com problemas de otimização, dai eles vem e lançam uma engine nova e ainda mais bugada.

replies.author: Ok_Command_3730
replies.body: I completely disagree. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 literally won GOTY in 2025, proving how incredible a UE5 project can be. On top of that, we have highly optimized multiplayer games like Arc Raiders running flawlessly. It’s not the engine's fault, it’s all about how much effort developers put into optimization. UE5 is delivering masterpieces.

replies.author: PhoenixxBR
replies.body: Sim, obviamente existe alguns jogos que se sairam bem na Unreal Engine 5, mas são tão poucos, que deixa aquela dúvida, se a Unreal Engine 6 realmente vai ser boa, ou vai expor ainda mais o que já vimos na UE5.

replies.author: AimDev
replies.body:
I'll do short version instead of big info dump. People think UE5 games are unoptimized because of a combination of 3 reasons

1. UE5 is free to use to a lot of dev make a lot of games even if they have no experience as a game dev. The games will run but they will do little or no optimization sometimes. The dev has to 

2. UE5 has a lot of really cool things it can do that are also really complicated to use. UE5 is marketed to devs with the shiny cool stuff so the devs want to use it. Most devs do not know how to use the shiny cool stuff so their games run like ass. 


3. Big companies that have the devs and resources to optimize implement the cool stuff in optimized ways are always lead by corpos. Games make money from content, not bug fixes or optimization. The amount of times I have heard "If they experience that bug then we already have their money"


Also, use English on the internet. Impolite to force translation when we have a world language

replies.author: PhoenixxBR
replies.body: Reddit tem tradutor automatico, indelicado é usar uma plataforma que une todos idiomas e não usar os recursos da plataforma e criticar usuarios por usarem seus idiomas nativos.

replies.author: AimDev
replies.body: Reddit is an American company. We speak English here

replies.author: JohnySilkBoots
replies.body: Unreal is insanely good. People claiming it is “bad” have no idea what they are talking about. It’s an engine. If you know how to use it, it is absolutely amazing. I mean, huge companies like Square Enix, Bandai, Arc Systems all use it, and their games run/look amazing.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: It takes a while to make a AAA game. The day you get U5 is not the day they release a U5 game. The day you get a PlayStation 5 is the day you get a PS5 exclusive because studios had been working on that for years already.

replies.author: PhoenixxBR
replies.body:
UE5 é cheio de defeito e toda bugada, não sei porque tem fanboy que gosta de defender a Epic, a pior empresa de jogos do mercado, até a Unity tem menos problemas que a UE5, e olha que a Unity tambem tem seus problemas, mas nada comparado a UE5, na era eda UE3 ou UE4, nenhuma empresa dava essas desculpas que vocês estão dando para defender a UE5, jogos eram fabricados em torno de 2 a 3 anos e saiam sem nenhum bug ou mal otimizados. Até mesmo jogos criados em 1 ano, eram decentes e tinham menos problemas, eu consumo jogos desde a descada de 90, vi essa industria crescer desde os tempos primordios da UE1 e nada resume o que a UE5 se tornou, uma engine que cria 99% de lixo mal otimizado e cheio de bugs.  
E estudios não são culpados e nunca seram, a engine existe justamente para facilitar a vida de um estudio de criação de jogos, se ela não consegue fazer isso, ela tem um defeito.

comments.author: shlaifu
comments.body: chill out, they revealed the logo, that's all

comments.author: Batty2551
comments.body:
They will most likely do an AI powered engine now. There is no reason for them to keep the same Unreal Engine 5 when Unity is already got their AI engine in now. 

I don't agree this is the direction and should just be a new standalone AI engine leaving normal Game Engine's as basic and simple as possible so there is still a path but knowing Epic they don't care for the end user.
